item.title: Higashi Chaya District: Kanazawa's Best-Preserved Geisha Quarter — Guide
item.description: Higashi Chaya District is Kanazawa’s largest and best-preserved geisha entertainment quarter, its streets lined with distinctive wooden latticed teahouses (chaya) dating back to the early 19th century, some of which still operate as working teahouses hosting geisha performances today. Beyond its historic architecture, the district is now also known for shops selling Kanazawa’s famous gold leaf crafts and traditional sweets, many housed within the same beautifully preserved wooden buildings that once hosted the entertainment district’s original clientele.
